title: Products I've built & shipped.
intro: A live portfolio of platforms — most are open on GitHub. Filter by what you're looking for.

projects.name: amanoba
projects.text: Gamified learning platform — courses delivered by email and in-app, with quizzes, achievements, a 50-level XP system and leaderboards. Powers the "AI 30 Nap" program.

projects.name: messmass
projects.text: Enterprise platform for sports organisations and venues: real-time live-event reporting, sponsorship analytics, report authoring and Bitly attribution — in one product.

projects.name: hatori
projects.text: Local-first personal AI assistant. Private, auditable, and learns from real usage via a RAG pipeline. "Everything started here."

projects.name: narimato
projects.text: Anonymous, session-based card-ranking engine. Multi-tenant by organisation, seven play modes, and ELO-based global rankings — built mobile-first.

projects.name: reply
projects.text: Local-first macOS communication workspace. Ingests your message sources, assembles contact context, and drafts message-backed replies.

projects.name: sso
projects.text: Universal SSO service for the DoneIsBetter ecosystem — centralised auth with OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect, magic links and social login.

projects.name: spot
projects.text: {spot} — Smart Platform for Observing Threats. AI-assisted content classification over batched social-media data using deterministic local inference.

projects.name: misisimi
projects.text: "CMS for the rest" — a lightweight content management system built for non-enterprise teams who still want to ship fast.
